acceptance_gate.honesty_condition: the honest score is always preserved; never convert to 10/10 because the human likes the work
acceptance_gate.note: the bar is 9.0 WITH no critical failures; a 9.2 average with a critical failure is NOT shippable

conflict_c1_resolution.issue: doc 12 'do not normally accept below 9.5' vs ratified 9.0 auto-approval bar
conflict_c1_resolution.resolution: no conflict — doc 12 names 9.5 a default acceptance threshold, not a mathematical law; permits 9.2/9.0 acceptance with the honest score preserved, which IS the auto-approval honesty condition
conflict_c1_resolution.verdict: the 9.0 bar stands; doc 12 is the method SN-0340 commands

critical_failure_rule.predicate: critical_failures > 0 => NOT shippable, regardless of weighted_score
critical_failure_rule.statement: A weighted average must never hide a catastrophic defect. A beautiful failure is still a failure.

oscar_protocol.master_question: DID NAYA ACTUALLY DEMONSTRATE INTELLIGENCE HERE — OR DID SHE MERELY SOUND INTELLIGENT?
